subject: GitHub credential ACL repair local validation and VM access recheck

checks: PowerShell parser accepted modules/RIDE.GitHubAuthentication.psm1 and the four repaired Pester suites.
Created a non-secret temporary file under repository .local, applied Set-RideGitHubCredentialFileAcl, and passed Assert-RideGitHubPath -CheckAcl.
Observed file owner was the current user, allowed identities were current user and SYSTEM only, and DACL inheritance was disabled.

Credential writer created a new restricted credential directory, wrote a synthetic DPAPI-protected record, atomically replaced it, and retained the verified owner/allow-list/protected-DACL properties.

An initial diagnostic intentionally pre-created the credential directory with inherited permissions; initialization correctly rejected it. The corrected writer check used a new absent directory and passed.
Temporary validation directory was removed after the check.
triage: The first local Pester invocation left the optional TestRegistry plugin enabled; sandbox-denied HKCU access prevented test bodies from running.

With plugins disabled, four fixture failures were exposed and repaired: an ACL test changed the real file DACL, mock module names used RIDE.Packages instead of RIDE-Packages, and a hash test used a .NET API unavailable to Windows PowerShell 5.1.
The final focused run passed all 98 tests.
